name: Balkeshwar Mahadev Temple
town_description: Agra, in western Uttar Pradesh on the banks of the Yamuna, is world-famous for the Taj Mahal, Agra Fort and Fatehpur Sikri. Balkeshwar is a northern locality of the city, known for the Balkeshwar Ghat on the Yamuna, the temple, and the nearby Kailash Nagar and Kamla Nagar areas.

travel.airport: Pandit Deen Dayal Upadhyay Airport, Agra (Kheria), approx. 13-17 km.
travel.railway: Agra Cantt and Agra Fort stations (roughly 6-10 km; autos/taxis).
travel.road: About 1.5 km from the Water Works area on the Yamuna bank; local buses, autos and taxis within Agra city.

visitor_information.best_time: Sawan month (July-August) for the Monday fairs; October-March for pleasant weather.
visitor_information.opening_hours: See original record: morning 6:00 AM to 12:30 PM; evening 4:30 PM to 10:00 PM, open all days (verify).
